reported.quote: Our revenues grew 0.6% sequentially and 1.7% year-on-year in constant currency terms.
We generated free cash flow of $915 mn.
Momentum in Financial Services continues with 3.9% year-on-year growth in constant currency terms.
Among geos, Europe continued to lead the growth by 7.2% year-on-year in constant currency terms.
Large deal TCV was robust at $4.8 bn in Q3 with 57% net new.
Yield on cash balance was at 6.19% and ROE stood at 32.8%.

guidance.quote: The new revenue growth guidance for this financial year is 3% to 3.5% growth in constant currency.
Our operating margin guidance for the financial year remains the same at 20% to 22%.
